registers.name: GICD_IGROUPR<n>E
registers.description: Interrupt Group Registers (extended SPI range)。GIC Distributor 寄存器

fields.name: Group_status_bit<x>
fields.description: Group status bit. If 亲和路由 is enabled 用于 中断安全状态中，对应中断的 bit 与 GICD_IGRPMODR<n>E 组成 2-bit 字段定义中断分组。 此字段编码在 GICD_IGRPMODR<n>E. 若亲和路由禁用 用于 Security state of an interrupt, the bit is RES0: [0b0=当 GICD_CTLR.DS==1, the corresponding interrupt is Group ; 0b1=当 GICD_CTLR.DS==1, the corresponding interrupt is Group ]
